name: Crisis Communications
description: Communicate rapidly and accurately during a fast-moving crisis using a known/unknown/action ledger, coordinated channels, and explicit corrections.

tasks.name: Establish situation and audiences
tasks.objective: Identify confirmed event, affected audiences, harms or risks, information needs, channels, accessibility and language needs, spokesperson or authority, and operational source of truth.

tasks.name: Build known/unknown/action ledger
tasks.objective: Maintain verified facts, unknowns, rumors needing response, actions underway, public protective actions, and next expected update. Timestamp every material change.

tasks.name: Draft first message
tasks.objective: Communicate quickly but accurately: what happened, who is affected, what people should do now, what the organization is doing, what is not yet known, and when and where the next update will appear.

tasks.name: Coordinate channels and spokespeople
tasks.objective: Align internal leadership, frontline or support teams, partners, media and public channels, and translations around one current fact set while tailoring format to audience needs.

tasks.name: Monitor response and misinformation
tasks.objective: Track questions, confusion, rumor spread, accessibility failures, conflicting official statements, and changes in risk. Correct errors plainly without amplifying fringe claims unnecessarily.

tasks.name: Run update cadence
tasks.objective: Publish meaningful updates when facts or actions change or at promised intervals. Preserve prior statements and explicitly correct superseded information.

tasks.name: Post-crisis communication review
tasks.objective: Evaluate timeliness, accuracy, reach, comprehension, accessibility, corrections, spokesperson consistency, and trust impacts; turn failures into concrete playbook and template changes.
